actions.create_page.description: Creates a new Qwilr page from saved blocks or template.
actions.create_page.props.acceptSettings: Configures settings for the accept block in the template being used. Only relevant if you have an accept block.
actions.create_page.props.metadata.descr: Data you provide, that will be returned as part of all Webhooks.
actions.create_page.props.name.descripti: Title of the page, visible as the browser page title
actions.create_page.props.ownerId.descri: ID of the user that should own the page. If not specified, the owner of the access token will be the owner of the page.
actions.create_page.props.published.desc: Whether the page is publicly available; false means the page will be in Draft status
Mapping of token API reference keys to substitution values used throughout the page.
actions.create_page.props.tags.descripti: The tags for your page. Tags are case-sensitive.
actions.create_page.props.templateId.des: ID of the template to use for the page
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
